The Bose premium audio system delivers quality sound for your favorite content. Wireless charging keeps your devices powered throughout your day. description: If you're searching for a 2009 Acura TL Tech SH-AWD for sale in Spokane, WA, this gray sedan at Auction Direct Motorsports deserves a serious look. Priced at $7,500 with 163,630 miles, it represents exactly the kind of value-forward purchase that savvy buyers in the Spokane area have come to expect from this dealership. At 163,630 miles, this vehicle has clearly been driven, but that shouldn't scare informed buyers away. Honda and Acura powertrains from this era are known to run well into the 200,000-mile range with consistent maintenance, and the 3.7L V6 paired with SH-AWD is one of the more robust combinations the brand has ever produced. The gray exterior gives it a clean, understated executive presence that holds up well against the test of time.2009 Acura TL Performance and EngineThe 3.7L V6 and SH-AWD SystemThe 3.7L VTEC V6 in the SH-AWD TL produces 305 horsepower, making it genuinely quick for its class and era. Paired with a five-speed automatic transmission, it delivers smooth, confident power across the full RPM range. What truly separates this trim from the standard TL, however, is the Super Handling All-Wheel Drive system. SH-AWD doesn't just distribute torque front to rear  it actively vectors torque left and right across the rear axle, dramatically improving cornering grip and stability. The Premium Package elevates your driving experience with heated front seatsa welcome comfort during colder months. The second row sunshades help keep rear passengers comfortable on bright days. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road while managing entertainment preferences.  Safety systems work behind the scenes to help protect your journey. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and an overhead airbag provide comprehensive coverage. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control enhance handling on various road surfaces. Rear parking sensors alert you to obstacles when backing up, while brake assist supports your stopping power when you need it most.  This Rogue SV combines genuine utility with attentive comfort features. The 25 city and 32 highway MPG efficiency keeps fuel stops reasonable for your budget. Fully automatic headlights adjust to changing light conditions without manual intervention. The rear window wiper and speed-sensitive wipers maintain visibility in rain or snow. With split-folding rear seats, you adapt the interior layout to accommodate passengers or cargo as your needs shift. description: 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab LT Trail Boss 4WD 6.2L V8 COMES WITH THE COMPLETE EMERSON WARRANTY EMERSON CHEVROLET | HASSLE FREE SINCE 1963  Peak Performance, Unleashed Power: 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab LT Trail Boss 4WD 6.2L V8 at Emerson Chevrolet Some trucks are designed to get you from point A to point B, and others are engineered to conquer the rugged, unpredictable terrain of Maine without breaking a sweat. If you are looking for a pickup that refuses to compromise on muscle, factory-lifted capability, or premium cabin comfort, we have the ultimate machine waiting for you on our lot. Right now, parked at 946 Center Street in Auburn , Emerson Chevrolet is proud to showcase an absolute giant: a pristine 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab LT Trail Boss 4WD , powered by the monstrous, top-tier 6.2L EcoTec3 V8 engine . This isn t just your average half-ton truck. When you combine the factory-tuned off-road prowess of the Trail Boss package with the largest, most powerful naturally aspirated V8 in Chevrolets arsenal, you get a pickup that sits at the very apex of performance. The Apex of Small Block V8 Muscle: The 6.2L EcoTec3 V8 While the standard engine options on the Silverado are formidable, the legendary 6.2-liter V8 is in a class entirely of its own. It represents the ultimate upgrade for truck enthusiasts who demand maximum towing muscle, sports-car-like acceleration, and a deep, authoritative exhaust note. Massive Power output: The 6.2L V8 unleashes a jaw-dropping 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque , giving you effortless, instantaneous power whether you are hauling heavy equipment up a steep grade or passing traffic on the turnpike. Advanced 10-Speed Automatic Transmission: This powerhouse engine is paired with a highly sophisticated 10-speed automatic transmission. With more closely spaced gear ratios, the truck always finds the perfect power band, maximizing mechanical efficiency while ensuring gear shifts are seamless and instantaneous. Dynamic Fuel Management: To keep your fuel budget in check, the engine utilizes Chevrolets smart fuel-management system. It continuously monitors driving conditions and can deactivate cylinders in up to 17 different patterns, transitioning into a fuel-sipping mode when cruising down the highway without sacrificing an ounce of V8 power when you step on the gas. Heavy-Duty Towing Capability: Thanks to the immense torque of the 6.2L V8, this Silverado handles heavy-duty towing with absolute confidence. Complete with an integrated trailer brake controller and Chevy s smart Hitch Guidance system, hitching up a camper, boat, or equipment trailer is a simple, one-person task. Factory-Built Trail Boss Grit: Engineered for the Maine Wilderness The Trail Boss badge is a promise of legendary off-road capability, engineered straight from the assembly line to handle brutal terrain. Unlike aftermarket lift kits that can compromise daily ride quality or void warranties, the Trail Boss features a fully integrated suite of rugged off-road hardware built to endure the elements: 2-Inch Factory Suspension Lift: Gives the truck an imposing, high-riding stance right out of the box. This added ground clearance improves your approach, departure, and breakover angles, letting you clear rugged trail obstacles or heavy winter snowdrifts with total confidence. Z71 Off-Road Suspension Package: Features heavy-duty Rancho monotube shocks specifically tuned to soak up rough, unpaved washboard roads while maintaining excellent body control and stability on paved Auburn streets. Autotrac 2-Speed Transfer Case: Provides a dedicated low-range setting for crawling through deep mud, sand, or rocky inclines, alongside an Auto mode that shifts into four-wheel drive automatically the moment it senses traction loss on black ice or wet asphalt. Automatic Locking Rear Differential: When the going gets slippery, the rear differential locks automatically to distribute power evenly to both rear wheels, pulling you through deep mud or winter slush. Rugged Underbody Protection: High-strength steel skid plates shield the front underbelly, steering gear, and transfer case from stray rocks and debris. Aggressive Styling: The off-road aesthetic is completed by high-gloss black 18-inch aluminum wheels wrapped in aggressive Goodyear Wrangler DuraTrac mud-terrain tires, framed by iconic Performance Red recovery hooks on the front bumper. The Crew Cab Advantage: Premium Space and the Durabed This Silverado features the highly sought-after Crew Cab configuration , meaning no one has to compromise on interior comfort. The rear cabin offers massive, class-leading legroom that allows tall adults to stretch out comfortably on long road trips across New England. Behind the spacious cab sits Chevys revolutionary Durabed . Engineered from high-strength roll-formed steel, it offers more cargo volume than any competitor in its class. It comes equipped with 12 standard tie-down points, bright LED cargo area lighting, and the incredibly convenient EZ Lift power lock and release tailgate . Step Inside: Comfort Meets Modern Tech While the exterior of the LT Trail Boss is rugged and aggressive, stepping inside the cabin feels like entering a premium sanctuary. The LT trim represents the absolute sweet spot of the Silverado lineup, replacing basic utility with a long list of comfort and convenience features: Heated Front Seats Heated Steering Wheel: A true lifesaver on freezing Maine mornings, ensuring you stay warm and cozy before the engine even reaches temperature. 10-Way Power-Adjustable Driver s Seat: Allows you to find the perfect driving position for maximum comfort on long-distance highway hauls. 8-Inch Diagonal Color Touchscreen: Running the intuitive Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system, which includes standard Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility so you can access navigation, stream playlists, and make hands-free calls seamlessly. Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control: Keeps both the driver and front passenger perfectly comfortable with individualized temperature settings. Comprehensive Safety: Chevy Safety Assist Your safety is a top priority, which is why the 2021 Silverado comes equipped with advanced safety technologies designed to protect you and your passengers on every journey: Forward Collision Alert with Automatic Emergency Braking. Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning. Front and Rear Park Assist to make navigating tight parking lots stress-free. Blind-Spot Monitoring and Rear Cross-Path Detection for safer lane changes and backup confidence. The Emerson Chevrolet Promise Buying a truck shouldn t feel like a gamble. At Emerson Chevrolet, every pre-owned vehicle that hits our Auburn lot undergoes a strict, multi-point mechanical and safety inspection by our factory-trained technicians. We verify everything from brake pad wear to complex electronic systems so you can drive home with absolute confidence. Test Drive this 6.2L V8 Trail Boss Today! A late-model, low-mileage 2021 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT Trail Boss equipped with the legendary 6.2L V8 is one of the most highly sought-after trucks on the market today. It offers the perfect blend of raw muscle, unstoppable off-road capability, and everyday luxury that Maine drivers look for. description: 2021 GMC Yukon AT4 4WD 5.3L V8 COMES WITH THE COMPLETE EMERSON WARRANTY EMERSON CHEVROLET | HASSLE FREE SINCE 1963  Conquer the Maine Elements in Luxury: The 2021 GMC Yukon AT4 4WD has Arrived at Emerson Chevrolet! When it comes to navigating the changing seasons in Maine, you need a vehicle that doesn t just adaptit dominates. From navigating heavy winter snowfalls along Route 4 to embarking on summer family road trips up to Moosehead Lake, your vehicle needs to be a sanctuary of comfort, a powerhouse of capability, and a fortress of safety. Enter the 2021 GMC Yukon AT4 4WD , now available on the lot at Emerson Chevrolet in Auburn, Maine. This isn t just any large SUV. The AT4 designation represents GMCs premium off-road breed, seamlessly marrying rugged tactical capability with sophisticated, high-end luxury. If youve been searching for a premium three-row vehicle that can haul the family, tow the boat, and conquer dirt roads without breaking a sweat, your destination is 946 Center Street. Unmistakable Presence: Premium Rugged Design The 2021 model year marked a massive, ground-up redesign for the GMC Yukon, introducing a longer wheelbase, vastly improved interior packaging, and a commanding new design language. In the AT4 trim , that design language gets a heavy dose of athletic attitude. The Yukon AT4 stands out immediately from standard SUVs with its distinct, factory-customized exterior elements: Unique Front Fascia Skid Plate: The AT4 features a redesigned front bumper that optimizes the approach angle for off-road obstacles, complemented by a rugged steel skid plate to protect vital underbody components. Dark Chrome Accents: Replacing the traditional bright chrome found on the Denali, the AT4 utilizes black chrome and gloss-black accents on the grille, windows, and trim for a stealthy, modern aesthetic. Signature Red Recovery Hooks: Prominently displayed on the front bumper, these heavy-duty hooks are both highly functional and a visual badge of honor for GMC s off-road lineup. 20-Inch Machined Aluminum Wheels: Paired with aggressive all-terrain tires, this rolling stock gives the Yukon a muscular stance and exceptional grip on unpredictable terrain. Whether its parked outside a downtown Lewiston restaurant or navigating a muddy camp road, the Yukon AT4 looks entirely in its element. The Heart of a Towing Titan: The 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 Underneath the sculpted hood of this Yukon AT4 lives a legendary American powerplant: the 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 engine . Delivering a robust 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque , this naturally aspirated V8 provides the smooth, linear power delivery that heavy-duty family haulers demand. Engineered for Real-World Capability GMC paired this powerhouse V8 with a highly advanced 10-speed automatic transmission . This combination ensures that the engine is always in its ideal power band, whether you re accelerating past a slow-moving tractor on a two-lane state highway or cruising efficiently down I-95. For Maine drivers, capability is non-negotiable. This Yukon AT4 is equipped with a true 4WD system featuring a two-speed transfer case. You can easily switch between 2WD for dry summer highways, Auto mode for variable winter roads, and 4WD High/Low when the terrain gets truly challenging. Combined with its impressive towing capacity, this SUV is fully prepared to pull your camper, boat, or snowmobile trailers anywhere in New England. First-Class Cabin: Space, Luxury, and Innovation While the exterior of the Yukon AT4 signals rugged capability, opening the door reveals an upscale oasis designed to keep up to eight passengers enveloped in absolute luxury. Thanks to the 2021 redesign, this generation of Yukon offers a massive increase in passenger spaceparticularly in the third rowand vastly more cargo room than previous generations. AT4-Exclusive Luxury The interior of our 2021 Yukon AT4 features premium, jet-black leather seating surfaces accented with exclusive AT4-specific brandy contrast stitching and embroidered headrests. Heated and Ventilated Front Seats: Stay perfectly comfortable whether it s a humid July afternoon or a sub-zero January morning. Heated Second-Row Captain s Chairs: Your passengers receive the same VIP treatment, keeping everyone warm during extended road trips. Heated Steering Wheel: A mandatory luxury for Maine winters that warms your hands in seconds. A Masterclass in Cargo Utility One of the greatest achievements of the 2021 redesign is the integration of an Independent Rear Suspension . Beyond drastically improving ride quality and handling over bumpy roads, this mechanical upgrade allowed engineers to lower the interior floor. The result? A massive 122.9 cubic feet of maximum cargo space with the second and third rows folded flat. Even with all three rows occupied, you still enjoy a generous cargo area behind the third row for groceries, sports gear, or luggage. High-Tech Connectivity Advanced Safety A modern premium SUV demands modern technology, and this Yukon AT4 delivers on all fronts. Central Command The dashboard is anchored by a gorgeous, crisp 10.2-inch diagonal premium infotainment system . It operates on a lightning-fast interface that supports Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto . You can effortlessly stream your favorite playlists, access turn-by-turn navigation, and manage hands-free calls without ever plugging in a cable. Comprehensive Driver Assistance Safety is paramount when you are hauling precious cargo. The 2021 Yukon AT4 is packed with proactive safety systems designed to act as an extra pair of eyes on the road: Forward Collision Alert Automatic Emergency Braking Front Pedestrian Braking Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert (vital for highway driving) Rear Cross Traffic Alert (makes backing out of busy parking spaces a breeze) HD Rear Vision Camera with dynamic gridlines for easy parking and trailer hitching Why Buy From Emerson Chevrolet? At Emerson Chevrolet , we take immense pride in curated premium pre-owned vehicles that meet the rigid standards of Maine drivers. Our family-focused dealership on Center Street in Auburn is dedicated to providing an transparent, stress-free buying experience. When you choose to shop with us, you are getting: Thoroughly Inspected Inventory: Every pre-owned vehicle on our lot undergoes a rigorous multi-point safety and mechanical inspection by factory-certified technicians. Tailored Financial Solutions: Our experienced finance team works closely with local Maine credit unions and major national lenders to secure the absolute best rates and terms for your budget. Dedicated Customer Care: From the moment you walk through our doors to years down the road when you come back for routine service, you are treated like family. Experience the AT4 Difference Today Premium three-row SUVs with this level of off-road capability, towing power, and refined luxury do not sit on our lot for long. The 2021 GMC Yukon AT4 is the ultimate year-round companion for anyone looking to elevate their daily drive and weekend adventures. Don t wait!
